title: Na co dzień
audience: School-age learners from about 11 years old and adults. Universal themes that work for both: free time, school and learning, travel, food, health, technology, friends, nature, shopping, plans and experiences. Nothing about alcohol, violence, romance or adult working life as a presumed experience (jobs may appear as a topic). Polish explanations clear and friendly, light on terminology.
vocabGuide: Genuinely A2-B1 on the CEFR scale: everyday vocabulary beyond the first 1000 words, common phrasal verbs (look for, find out, give up, pick up), basic collocations (make a decision, take a photo, catch a cold), and at most two very common fixed expressions per week as "idiom" (take it easy, no way). No rare or abstract academic words.
